Terminal offsets have neither duplicates nor consecutive Fibonacci indices, hence form the unique Zeckendorf expansion of residue N mod F_a, with remaining g0 determined. All factorizations therefore join with <=3 steps. At 3F_a exactly two disjoint-support factorizations (3g0 and g_(a-2)+g_(a-1), a3 2g2) force distance three. Independent enumeration for a=3..9 verified all factorization graphs connect by distance <=3 and 3F_a witnesses, not replacing all-a proof.
